name: Shaggy Oyster
rule: Shaded spreader. Spreads like Oyster onto an adjacent empty Straw or Log square, but only grows beside a Tree.
blurb: Oyster shelves fringed with soft white teeth.
hint: A pale shelf with an icicle tooth beard. Look where the straw meets the logs.

name: Lacquer Cap
rule: Slow. Two growth phases at C. The most valuable thing your farm can grow.
hint: A brown log cap glazed like a lacquered shelf. Two logs, side by side, in the fall.

name: Ember Puff
rule: Hungry. Each time it fruits, it eats one adjacent empty Compost or Woodchip square.
blurb: A puffball blushing wine-red at the seams.
hint: A white orb under a burgundy cap. Chips beside compost, in the summer.

name: Frost Oyster
rule: Hardy but thirsty. Grows year-round and ignores Cold Snap, but gets blight after one dry mark instead of two.
blurb: Blue-grey shelves rimed like a January window.
hint: A pale shelf on velvet stems, rimed with frost. Straw beside a log as the year turns cold.
